description: This file defines a web component 'ComponentAgree' that extends a base 'WebComponent'. It loads some information from storage, constructs a label and switch input dynamically, and manages enabling/disabling a continuation button based on user interaction. The component is registered as a custom element with the name 'account-register'.

classes.name: ComponentAgree
classes.description: A web component that displays a label and switch based on stored information and manages user interaction for agreement.

methods.name: connected()
methods.description: Asynchronously loads information from storage, updates the inner HTML with a label and switch, and sets up an event listener for change events.

methods.name: onChange(e)
methods.description: Handles change events on the agreement input, enabling or disabling the continue button accordingly.
